# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: the bones of a player firing and reloading on the move.
# map mp_carentan, gametype dm (served as probe_torso), one client joined allies with the
# m1carbine_mp. Two shells, the gsc probe first, then the client about 6 s later:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=32571 PROBE_SECS=80 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_torso mp_carentan
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:32571 --probe-team allies --save-legs \
#       --capture-tag torso --probe-secs 70
# probe_torso.gsc puts the player on the street at (932, -376, -151.875) at level time
# 25000 and links a script_origin to each tag below with zero offsets; the client half
# (-legs-client-torso.txt) is the walk it did from there: fire standing, running,
# strafing, crouched, crouch-running and aimed, reloads backing, strafing and crouched.
# This file is the server half, games_mp.log's PROBE lines, per server frame:
#   PROBE o <time> <player origin>
#   PROBE b <time> <k> <bone origin> <bone angles>
# The log ends at the probe's 560th frame. docs/research/cod11-movers.md, section 15,
# "Torso over legs", is what it measured.
